import CategoryTheory.UniverseLevel

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target (w : CategoryTheory.uliftFunctor.{u, v}.EssSurj) : UnivLE.{max u v, v} := by
  let F := CategoryTheory.uliftFunctor.{u, v}
  let h_ess_surj : F.EssSurj := w
  let h_univ : UnivLE.{u, v} := UniverseLevel.univ_le_of_ess_surj F h_ess_surj
  let h_max : UnivLE.{max u v, v} := UniverseLevel.univ_le_trans _ _ _ _ h_univ
  exact h_max
